analyst_view.overall: Académico de Viseu (6th, 20 points) host Alverca (11th, 12 points) at the Fontelo after the international break. Bruno Pinheiro's Viseu won six in a row before losing 1-0 at Nacional, no injuries or bans have been reported for them, and Pinheiro praises Alverca's technical quality and high pressing. Sérgio Ferreira's Alverca are out of the cup and without a league win since mid-October; A Bola (23-24 Nov) says right-sided defender Nabil Touaizi has a calf relapse and may not play again this year, Meupiyou and Abdulai are still recovering from knee surgery and Rayan Lucas is doubtful with a knee problem, while internationals Bojang, Chissumba, Merheg and Camara are back. The numbers count Meupiyou, Abdulai and Raveyre but not Touaizi or Rayan Lucas (both from A Bola only). Vítor Ferreira (Braga FA) referees; his record is not in the numbers. News on Viseu was thin, so the view stays close to the numbers with a small trim on corners.

goals.text: The numbers say 2.5 goals, with Meupiyou and Abdulai already taken out for Alverca. Alverca's attack has gone quiet in recent rounds and Rayan Lucas is a doubt, but their back line is also short with Touaizi out, which the numbers don't know, and Pinheiro says Viseu often come from behind at the Fontelo; these pull in opposite directions, so I stay at 2.5.

corners.text: The numbers say 8.2 corners, with Alverca taking the larger share (5.0) against a Viseu side that conceded 40 in its last six (already counted). I trim a little, to about 8.0, because Alverca lose Touaizi on the right flank and possibly Rayan Lucas, neither in the numbers, which should take something off their wide play; A Bola is the only source for both, so the trim stays small.

cards.text: The numbers say 4.6 cards, already adding a little because Viseu have been booked more than usual lately (19 in their last six). Vítor Ferreira was named referee, but I found nothing on his card record and the numbers have not used one; Alverca's high press could bring some fouls, yet there is no rivalry or special stakes, so I stay at 4.6.

shots.text: The numbers say 26.5 shots, with Alverca shooting more (14.8) after an 11% boost for their recent volume. Their absences are mostly in defence and midfield, the returning internationals give them their usual front line, and Viseu's squad is fit, so I see no reason to move it and stay at 26.5.

shots_on_target.text: The numbers say 9.1 shots on target. Viseu's forwards, led by André Clóvis, have been accurate this season and Alverca's finishing has dipped, both already in the recent form the numbers count; with no new absences in attack confirmed (Rayan Lucas is only a doubt), I stay at 9.1.
